name: The Last Train Until Tomorrow
source:
On a cold night, waiting for her train, a woman gets a call from a stranger – a stranger who knows knows her well.

[From [url=https://lynton-vale.itch.io/the-last-train-until-tomorrow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
寒冷的夜裡，一名女子正在等車，卻接到一個陌生人的電話。一個對她瞭如指掌的陌生人。

［摘自[url=https://lynton-vale.itch.io/the-last-train-until-tomorrow]itch.io[/url]］
